subject: Pipeline shelf-life & commit cleanse: Q3 runway risk and stage hygiene
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pipeline shelf-life & commit cleanse: Q3 runway risk and stage hygiene

Team —

We’re seeing a couple of clusters of risk in the Q3 runway after the latest ingestion: several deals in Discovery and Eval have not had stage movement in >60 days, and our committed pool looks light versus target. I’ve attached a simple sheet (Q3_Pipeline_ShelfLife.xlsx) — please do a quick hygiene pass by EOD Thursday: 

- Update stages to reflect current state (don’t leave staged as "Eval" if they’ve paused)
- For opportunities with last contact >90 days, mark as Stale or move to On Hold and add a next-step note
- Confirm any true commits (legal + PO in hand) with Rishi so Finance has the right run rate
- If you think a deal is commitable but needs acceleration, add a one-line mutual action plan in the notes and flag me

I’ll run a consolidated deck Friday afternoon for the leadership checkpoint. Priority accounts where we need clarity: NIM-4721, ACME-188, and MEDCO-33 — if you own one of these call out the expected close date.

Thanks — small, fast hygiene will meaningfully tighten the Q3 view.

Kimberly Park
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Kimberly.Park@redwood.com

Attachment: Q3_Pipeline_ShelfLife.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline shelf-life & commit cleanse: Q3 runway risk and stage hygiene

Kimberly — thanks for the nudge. I’ll run a sweep today and tidy notes. Quick asks: 

1) For NIM-4721 (Alyssa Chen), I last heard procurement needed an internal budget approval that was pushed — can someone confirm the new PO timeline? I don’t want to mark stale if they’re actively in procurement.

2) For MEDCO-33, Marcus owns the deal but I’ve included a provisional probability change in the sheet (moved from 70% -> 40%) pending legal confirmation.

I’ll flag any spots where I need help re-prioritizing outreach.

- Laura
AE, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline shelf-life & commit cleanse: Q3 runway risk and stage hygiene

Looping in a Finance view — thanks Kim. I pulled a quick run-rate sensitivity and attached NIM-4721 into scenario C (conservative): if NIM slips to next quarter our committed vs target gap increases by ~$520k with current weighting. I’ve added three quick guidance points in the sheet: 

- Only count as "commit" when Legal + Procurement (signed PO or DocuSign) are present. Verbal guidance is "probable" not committed.
- Reduce historical-age bias: deals without a contact in 90+ days should be treated as low confidence unless AE updates notes.
- For forecasting, include a 10% buffer on top of listed commit to cover churn/rate compression.

Attachment: NIM-4721_run_rate_scenarios.csv (CSV, 8KB)

I’ll coordinate with FinanceOps if we need to escalate a bridge ask to leadership.

- Rishi
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nimbushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pipeline shelf-life & commit cleanse: Q3 runway risk and stage hygiene

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the transparency. Quick clarification on our side for NIM-4721: procurement raised the internal budget request last week; legal is reviewing the redline. We expect procurement to issue a PO by the week of June 21, but that is still contingent on legal sign-off. I’ll put a note in the HubSpot deal "Procurement: expected PO wk of 6/21".

If Redwood can confirm general seat pricing/term finalization this week we can accelerate legal turn-around.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Director of AI Strategy, Nimbus Health
alyssa.chen@nimbushealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline shelf-life & commit cleanse: Q3 runway risk and stage hygiene

Thanks all — appreciate the quick updates. Action summary: 

- Laura: keep NIM-4721 as "Probable" until PO is in hand; add the HubSpot note Alyssa suggested and move probability to 50% in the sheet for conservative forecast.
- Marcus: confirm MEDCO legal timeline or move to On Hold by EOD Thursday if no update.
- Rishi: I agree on the commits rule — Legal + PO only. Please fold the conservative scenario into Friday’s leadership pack.
- Alyssa: thank you for the timing — if we can finalize seat counts/term sheet this week we’ll prioritize legal turnaround and try to close before 6/21.

I’ll close the hygiene pass and circulate the cleaned Q3 tab by Friday 9am PT. If anyone hits blockers DM me on Slack rather than email.

Kimberly Park
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Q3_Pipeline_ShelfLife.xlsx (updated)
